43393-at-the-councillor-s-or-a-nameless-.title: A Nameless History.
43393-at-the-councillor-s-or-a-nameless-.creator: Unknown
43393-at-the-councillor-s-or-a-nameless-.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. and sends a shudder through the nerves of many a brave man. A huge bedstead, the head and footboard clumsily painted with gaudy roses and carnations, and piled with feather-beds and patchwork quilts, stood directly in the broad light from the window, and upon this bed lay the castle miller.

arxiv-2111-01003.title: Conic bundle structures on ℚ \mathbb{Q} -Fano threefolds Thanks: The paper was partially supported by the HSE University Basic Research Program.
arxiv-2111-01003.creator: Yuri Prokhorov
arxiv-2111-01003.description: Abstract 1. Introduction A conic bundle is a proper flat morphism \pi:X\to Z of non-singular varieties such that it is of relative dimension 1 and the anticanonical divisor -K_{X} is relatively ample. We say that a variety X has a conic bundle structure if there exists a conic bundle \pi:X^{\prime}\to Z and a birational map X\dashrightarrow X^{\prime} .

arxiv-2302-12463.title: Pairing properties of semilocal coordinate&momentum-space regularized chiral interactions
arxiv-2302-12463.creator: P. Yin, X. L. Shang, J. N. Hu, J. Y. Fu, E. Epelbaum, W. Zuo
arxiv-2302-12463.description: Abstract We investigate the pairing properties of state-of-the-art semilocal coordinate-space and semilocal momentum-space regularized chiral interactions. Specifically, we calculate the pairing gaps in S 3 ​ D 1 {}^{3}SD_{1} channel of symmetric nuclear matter and in S 0 1 {}^{1}S_{0} and P 3 ​ F 2 {}^{3}PF_{2} channels of pure neutron matter within the BCS approximation using these chiral interactions.

arxiv-2307-16880.title: Remarks on the linear wave equation
arxiv-2307-16880.creator: John M. Ball
arxiv-2307-16880.description: Abstract . We make some remarks on the linear wave equation concerning the existence and uniqueness of weak solutions, satisfaction of the energy equation, growth properties of solutions, the passage from bounded to unbounded domains, and reconciliation of different representations of solutions. Dedicated to Bob Pego in admiration. 1. Introduction Let \Omega\subset\mathbb{R}^{n} be open with boundary \partial\Omega .

arxiv-2310-03738.title: Robust Novelty Detection through Style-Conscious Feature Ranking
arxiv-2310-03738.creator: Stefan Smeu Elena Burceanu Emanuela Haller Andrei Liviu Nicolicioiu
arxiv-2310-03738.description: Abstract Novelty detection seeks to identify samples deviating from a known distribution, yet data shifts in a multitude of ways, and only a few consist of relevant changes. Aligned with out-of-distribution generalization literature, we advocate for a formal distinction between task-relevant semantic or content changes and irrelevant style changes.

arxiv-2310-04366.title: Swordfish: A Framework for Evaluating Deep Neural Network-based Basecalling using Computation-In-Memory with Non-Ideal Memristors Conference: 56th Annual IEEE/ACM International Symposium on Microarchitecture; October 28-November 1, 2023; Toronto, ON, Canada 56th Annual IEEE/ACM International Symposi
arxiv-2310-04366.creator: Taha Shahroodi 1 Gagandeep Singh 2,3 Mahdi Zahedi 1 Haiyu Mao 3 Joel Lindegger 3 Can Firtina 3 Stephan Wong 1 Onur Mutlu 3 Said Hamdioui 1
arxiv-2310-04366.description: Abstract . Basecalling , an essential step in many genome analysis studies, relies on large Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) to achieve high accuracy. Unfortunately, these DNNs are computationally slow and inefficient, leading to considerable delays and resource constraints in the sequence analysis process. A Computation-In-Memory (CIM) architecture using memristors can significantly accelerate the performance of DNNs.

arxiv-2406-18134.title: Assessing “Implicit” Retrieval Robustness of Large Language Models
arxiv-2406-18134.creator: Xiaoyu Shen Rexhina Blloshmi Dawei Zhu Jiahuan Pei Wei Zhang
arxiv-2406-18134.description: Abstract Retrieval-augmented generation has gained popularity as a framework to enhance large language models with external knowledge. However, its effectiveness hinges on the retrieval robustness of the model. If the model lacks retrieval robustness, its performance is constrained by the accuracy of the retriever, resulting in significant compromises when the retrieved context is irrelevant.

arxiv-2408-05202.title: Twisted nanoporous graphene/graphene bilayers: electronic decoupling and chiral currents
arxiv-2408-05202.creator: Xabier Diaz de Cerio, Aleksander Bach Lorentzen, Mads Brandbyge, Aran Garcia-Lekue
arxiv-2408-05202.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Xabier Diaz de Cerio, Aleksander Bach Lorentzen, Mads Brandbyge, Aran Garcia-Lekue. We investigate bilayers of nanoporous graphene (NPG), laterally bonded carbon nanoribbons, and graphene. The electronic and transport properties are explored as a function of the interlayer twist angle using an atomistic tight-binding model combined with non-equilibrium Green’s functions. At small twist angles ( θ ≲ 10 ∘ \theta\lesssim 10^{\circ} ), NPG and graphene are strongly coupled, as revealed by the hybridization of their electronic bands.

arxiv-2506-15921.title: Systematic non-thermal velocity increase preceding soft X-ray flare onset Journal: ApJ
arxiv-2506-15921.creator: Andy S.H. To, Abigail Burden, Deborah Baker, Henrik Eklund, David H. Brooks, Laura A. Hayes, Juan Martínez-Sykora, Paola Testa, Jeffrey Reep, Miho Janvier, Shinsuke Imada, Julio Hernandez Camero, David M. Long, Teodora Mihailescu, Micah J. Weberg
arxiv-2506-15921.description: Abstract Non-thermal velocities, derived from spectral line broadening, can provide crucial insights into plasma dynamics before and during solar flares. To systematically study the pre-flare phase, we constructed a Hinode/Extreme-ultraviolet Imaging Spectrometer (EIS) flare catalog of 1,449 flares from 2011-2024. This enabled a large-scale analysis of flare loop footpoint non-thermal velocities evolution across different flare magnitudes (C, M, X-classes).

arxiv-2508-16870.title: JUDGEBERT : Assessing Legal Meaning Preservation Between Sentences
arxiv-2508-16870.creator: David Beauchemin, Michelle Albert-Rochette, Richard Khoury, Pierre-Luc DézielUniversité Laval, Québec, Canada, Computer Science Department, Faculty of Law david.beauchemin@ift.ulaval.ca , michelle.albert-rochette.1@ulaval.carichard.khoury@ift.ulaval.ca , pierre-luc.deziel@fd.ulaval.ca
arxiv-2508-16870.description: Abstract Simplifying text while preserving its meaning is a complex yet essential task, especially in sensitive domain applications like legal texts. When applied to a specialized field, like the legal domain, preservation differs significantly from its role in regular texts. This paper introduces FrJUDGE, a new dataset to assess legal meaning preservation between two legal texts.

arxiv-2510-24876.title: Convergence Analysis for an implementable scheme to solve the Linear-quadratic stochastic optimal control problem with stochastic wave equation
arxiv-2510-24876.creator: Abhishek Chaudhary
arxiv-2510-24876.description: Abstract . We study an optimal control problem for the stochastic wave equation driven by affine multiplicative noise, formulated as a stochastic linear–quadratic (SLQ) problem. By applying a stochastic Pontryagin’s maximum principle, we characterize the optimal state–control pair via a coupled forward–backward SPDE system.

arxiv-2512-01127.title: Mode-Conditioning Unlocks Superior Test-Time Scaling
arxiv-2512-01127.description: Abstract Parallel sampling promises substantial gains in test-time scaling, but its effectiveness is sharply limited by diversity collapse, where models concentrate on a few modes and repeated samples produce the same mistakes. We propose the mode-conditioning (ModC) framework , which explicitly allocates test-time compute across reasoning modes using either specialist models or mode-specific prefixes.

pmc-11334668.title: Successful treatment of sepsis-induced cardiomyopathy with 36 hours refractory ventricular fibrillation: A case report
pmc-11334668.creator: Songtao Liu, Zhixin Wu, Yi Su, Fucheng Qiu
pmc-11334668.description: Sepsis-induced cardiomyopathy (SIC) is generally characterized by decreased cardiac ejection fraction (EF) reversibility, less cardiac response to fluid resuscitation and catecholamine, and rarely complicated with refractory ventricular fibrillation (RVF). Once RVF is induced, the mortality rate of sepsis patients will be greatly increased.

pmc-11499912.title: Strong Lewis-acid coordinated PEO electrolyte achieves 4.8 V-class all-solid-state batteries over 580 Wh kg−1
pmc-11499912.creator: Hanwen An, Menglu Li, Qingsong Liu, Yajie Song, Jiaxuan Liu, Zhihang Yu, Xingjiang Liu, Biao Deng, Jiajun Wang
pmc-11499912.description: Polyethylene oxide (PEO) based electrolytes critically govern the security and energy density of solid-state batteries, but typically suffer from poor oxidation resistance at high voltages, which limits the energy density of batteries. Here, we report a Lewis-acid coordinated strategy to significantly improve the cyclic stability of 4.8 V-class PEO-based battery.

pmc-11520090.title: The relationship between fear of negative evaluation, physical activity, eating behavior and psychological distress among nursing students
pmc-11520090.creator: Xiao Zheng, Mengjie Zhang, Lingli Yang, Xinyi Zhang, Shujuan Xiao, Xinru Li, Benli Xue, Yanming Liao, Feng Tian, Chichen Zhang
pmc-11520090.description: BackgroundThe aim of this research is to explore the interrelationships between different psychological issues and the potential role of eating behavior and physical activity among nursing students.MethodsUndergraduate nursing students (n = 892) from some medical universities in China were recruited through convenience and snowball sampling methods using online platforms.

pmc-11656308.title: Symbiotic microbial population composition of Apolygus lucorum under temperature and pesticide pressures
pmc-11656308.creator: Mengxin Ma, Hui Xue, Xiangzhen Zhu, Li Wang, Lin Niu, Junyu Luo, Jinjie Cui, Xueke Gao
pmc-11656308.description: Insect population control using pesticides faces new challenges as global temperatures change. Symbiotic bacteria of insects play a key role in insect resistance to pesticides, and these symbiotic bacteria themselves are sensitive to the effects of temperature changes. Apolygus lucorum, a sucking pest, survives in a wide range of temperatures (15°C–35°C), and is presently controlled predominantly using the pesticide imidacloprid.

pmc-12731040.title: Effect of Moving Tactile Stimuli to Sole on Body Sway During Quiet Stance
pmc-12731040.creator: Taku Kawasaki, Yasushi Sawaguchi, Koichi Hiraoka
pmc-12731040.description: Objectives: This study examined whether moving tactile stimuli applied to the soles along the anterior–posterior (AP) and medial–lateral (ML) axes induce body sway during quiet stance. Methods: Fifteen healthy participants in quiet stance received plantar moving tactile stimuli along the AP or ML axis under occluded and unoccluded vision conditions.

pmc-13397544.title: Automated Parallel Synthesis Accelerates Virtual Screening Hit Discovery
pmc-13397544.creator: Sean M. McKenna, Martin Šícho, Cas van der Horst, Jesse Maasland, Edith van der Nol, Gianluca Turco, Andrius Bernatavicius, Gerard J.P. van Westen, Laura H. Heitman, Sebastian J. Pomplun
pmc-13397544.description: Virtual screening (VS) is a powerful approach to exploring a vast chemical space, encompassing libraries of millions to billions of compounds. However, the low hit rates of VS require testing numerous candidates to validate true binders, followed by iterative optimization cycles, which makes experimental validation costly and time-consuming.

pmc-13442859.title: A multi-objective particle swarm optimization algorithm with two-stage archive maintenance and auxiliary archive guidance
pmc-13442859.creator: Jing Zhang, Yanmin Liu, Yuci Li, Anna Dai, Ling Zhong, Siwan Chen
pmc-13442859.description: In Multi-objective particle swarm optimization (MOPSO), the external archive largely determines how well convergence and diversity are balanced. Ineffective archive maintenance may lead to uneven solution distributions, inaccurate convergence, and premature trapping in local regions.To overcome these limitations, this paper proposes TAMOPSO, a Two-stage Archive Maintenance-based Multi-Objective Particle Swarm Optimization algorithm.
